dict.string:
Turns on the bug button in the top-left of the Tags and Library tabs, where the features being worked on collect samples you can share: filament label scans, and Bluetooth scales.
While it is on, every label scan you finish reviewing is kept on this phone so you can send it later. Nothing is ever sent automatically and nothing is uploaded — each capture ends at a Share sheet you drive.
To send one, open an issue at github.com/marko-p/SpoolKid and attach the file.

SpoolKid occasionally asks whether you'd like to support its development. Turn this on to stop those prompts for good. Tapping a support link, or “Don’t show again” on the prompt itself, also turns it on — this switch is the way back off.

Enable this toggle, then reopen SpoolKid to clear ALL app data — including your on-device library (spools, filaments, manufacturers, locations), connection settings, remembered form data, recent tags, and tips. The app returns to its first-launch state. This toggle resets itself after the data is cleared.
